traceAs.steps/trust.cjs: inside the traced steps that keep or read a yes here: decisionbook.add, decisionbook.ready, decisionbook.gate, decisionbook.trust, decisionbook.session (run/verbs)
traceAs.steps/gate.cjs: inside the traced handlers decisionbook.gate (PreToolUse) and decisionbook.trust (PostToolUse) (run/verbs)
traceAs.run/verbs.cjs: the verb and handler table: every verb and hook handler is one traced step decisionbook.<verb>; the table has no step of its own
traceAs.steps/write.cjs: inside the traced steps decisionbook.create and decisionbook.add (run/verbs)
traceAs.steps/open.cjs: inside decisionbook.create and decisionbook.add (run/verbs, through steps/write and steps/batch); a refusal is the row's error code, going on and an aside are codes of the add's row
traceAs.steps/batch.cjs: inside decisionbook.create and decisionbook.add (run/verbs, through steps/write); n counts the records, the links and the unmet rows, a refusal is the row's error code
traceAs.steps/ready.cjs: inside decisionbook.ready, and decisionbook.create and decisionbook.add through steps/batch (run/verbs); n counts the unmet rows and the standards
traceAs.steps/close.cjs: inside the traced step decisionbook.close (run/verbs); n counts the commits read and the plan's own
traceAs.steps/closing.cjs: inside the traced steps that read a close no commit holds: decisionbook.close, decisionbook.gate, decisionbook.stop, decisionbook.prompt, decisionbook.inbox (run/verbs); a held turn is the stop row's code
traceAs.steps/read.cjs: inside the traced steps decisionbook.show, decisionbook.find, decisionbook.resume and the handlers decisionbook.gate, decisionbook.session, decisionbook.prompt (run/verbs)
traceAs.steps/protect.cjs: inside the traced step decisionbook.protect (run/verbs; setup's question is also the cli's own protect step)
traceAs.steps/store.cjs: the one reader and writer of .decisionbook/, inside every decisionbook.* step that reads or appends (run/verbs)
traceAs.steps/touch.cjs: git's count of commits since a decision, inside the steps that read decisions (decisionbook.show, decisionbook.resume, decisionbook.prompt)
traceAs.steps/recall.cjs: inside decisionbook.related, decisionbook.prompt and decisionbook.recall (run/verbs); n counts the seeds, the import step, the cards found and given
traceAs.steps/pack.cjs: inside decisionbook.prompt and decisionbook.pack (run/verbs); n counts the walk, packed and packChars
traceAs.steps/area.cjs: inside decisionbook.related, decisionbook.pack, decisionbook.prompt and decisionbook.recall (run/verbs), whose n it fills (n.built: cards with a built line)
traceAs.steps/changed.cjs: inside decisionbook.start, decisionbook.stop and decisionbook.shell (run/verbs), whose n says what git named
traceAs.steps/shell.cjs: inside decisionbook.shell (run/verbs); n counts the writes read, the files judged, unplaced writes, folders and a cut
traceAs.steps/stop.cjs: inside decisionbook.start and decisionbook.stop (run/verbs); n says whether a start was kept and the files changed
traceAs.steps/host.cjs: inside the traced handlers that read a host event (decisionbook.gate, decisionbook.trust, decisionbook.recall, decisionbook.shell)
traceAs.steps/here.cjs: the person's home rows, inside the traced steps that keep or read them (decisionbook.add, decisionbook.gate, decisionbook.trust, decisionbook.start, decisionbook.stop, decisionbook.recall)
traceAs.steps/standards.cjs: inside decisionbook.ready (run/verbs), whose n says standards, standardsDecided or standardsUnread
traceAs.steps/promise.cjs: inside the traced handlers decisionbook.gate and decisionbook.recall (run/verbs), whose n counts the promises, the broken imports and an ask already given
traceAs.steps/surface.cjs: inside the traced handlers decisionbook.gate and decisionbook.recall (run/verbs), through steps/promise
traceAs.steps/phase.cjs: writes the plan.phase rows itself (created, READY, the first allowed write) and the plan.flow rows (the first READY, the close), beside the traced step that reached the phase: decisionbook.create, decisionbook.add, decisionbook.ready, decisionbook.close, decisionbook.gate, decisionbook.prompt
traceAs.steps/inbox.cjs: inside the traced step decisionbook.inbox (run/verbs); n counts the rows of this branch and the pulled ones
traceAs.steps/why.cjs: inside the traced step decisionbook.why (run/verbs); n counts the commits blamed and the closed plans that list them
traceAs.steps/teammate.cjs: inside the traced steps that ask whose a plan or a line is: decisionbook.create, decisionbook.add, decisionbook.close and every reader that names a conflict (run/verbs)
traceAs.steps/source.cjs: inside decisionbook.create and decisionbook.add (run/verbs, through steps/batch): what the product read at a record's source decides the record's refusal code
traceAs.steps/pr.cjs: inside the traced step decisionbook.pr (run/verbs); n counts the plans described
